cc:Work.dc:description: Test PoC, functional measurements. Bounty V2 settlement, three challenged cases per configuration. Bars show means and error bars show sample standard deviations. Challenger residual is reward minus disclosure and measured dispute transaction fees. Coalition loss is operator penalty minus reward and disclosure credits. Negative residuals are retained. Unpriced computation, retries and capital lockup are excluded. These residuals are not profit or evidence of sustained audit participation.
